Telegram on teleproto, the maintained GramJS fork

Upgrade note: the Telegram client moves from GramJS, now archived, to
teleproto, its maintained fork. Nothing needs changing to upgrade: the same
session, .env and data volume keep working, and the session file is not
rewritten, so rolling back to 1.1.0 stays possible. Verified in production
with a real story published end to end.

Features
- Releases are announced on Telegram as a rich message once the image is
  published.
- Logging in asks for a login email and its code when Telegram requires one,
  instead of failing.

Fixes
- A revoked or expired Telegram session stops the bridge at once with a
  "run pnpm run login" message, instead of being retried as a network
  problem.
- brace-expansion raised to 5.0.12 for GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr (development only).
- A media server test no longer fails 1 run in 64.
